body.name: simultaneous admissible-regression event
body.construction: For \(x\ge1\), \(u=x+\log(2d)\), \(C_m>0\), and \(\widehat m\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), define \[\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)=\left\{\max_{r\in\{1,2,3,4\}}\max_{(j,b)\in\mathcal Q_d}\|\widehat m^{(r)}_{j,b}-m_{j,b}\|_{L^4(P_{C_{j,b}})}\le C_m\left(r_n+\sqrt{\frac{u}{n}}\right)\right\}.\]
